title: AAAI-27 Workshop Program
institution: Association for the Advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AAAI)
about: AAAI-27 runs 47 workshops on 22-23 February 2027 at the Palais des congrès, Montréal. Papers go directly to each workshop's organisers; the program page lists 20 November 2026 as the submission date and 2 December 2026 for notifications.
requirements: Submit directly to the individual workshop, not to AAAI
Individual workshop websites may list different deadlines or extensions

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Artificial intelligence research" (skills) → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Researchers and students" submitting workshop papers (seniority, description) → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
